sentences.en: Phosphorylation is an important step in the synthesis of ATP.
sentences.zh: 磷酸化是ATP合成的重要步骤。

sentences.en: Additive synthesis involves manually controlling harmonics, and uses only sine waves.
sentences.zh: 叠加合成涉及手动控制谐波，仅使用正弦波。

sentences.en: Love, in fact, is the agent of universal synthesis.
sentences.zh: 实际上，爱是普遍综合的媒介。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：syn（共同）+thesis（论题）→将相同的论题综合起来→综合
